description: Manipulates a draw.io-style workflow diagram with shapes, connectors, and canvas sizing.

actions.name: edit_diagram
actions.description: Apply one or more diagram operations in sequence.

operations.action: add_shape | update_shape | add_connector | update_connector | delete_element | resize_canvas
operations.label: Visible label

done_action.description: Return this action when the diagram already satisfies the task.

tips: Use target `diagram` for all executable actions.
Bundle related shape and connector edits into one action.
Prefer visible label, position, and connector changes over hidden metadata.
